messages.content: Imagine I just embarked on a lovely road trip and had to make a stop at the gas station. Would you be so kind as to assist me in filling up my car with 15 liters of gasoline? Fill with the second decimal digit precision in gallon. Once that's done, it would be fantastic if you could check the tire pressures as well—I'd love to share my impressive car maintenance skills with my Twitter followers with the message 'Just filled up the tank and checked the tire pressures. Ready for the next adventure!'. If you could also start up the engine and let me know the battery voltage and fuel level, that would be incredibly helpful.

4. Start engine: startEngine with ignitionMode "START".

5. Get battery voltage: There's no direct function for battery voltage. We have get_user_stats? No. For vehicle, we have displayCarStatus with option "battery". That returns status. Also get_fuel_level? Not listed. We have displayCarStatus options: "fuel", "battery", etc. So we can call displayCarStatus twice: one for "fuel" and one for "battery". Or maybe get_fuel_level not available. So we call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to get fuel level. And "battery" to get battery voltage.

Thus sequence: convert liter to gallon, fill fuel tank, check tire pressure, post tweet, start engine, displayCarStatus for battery, displayCarStatus for fuel.

We need to output the results. We'll do calls sequentially.')

messages.content: Imagine I just embarked on a lovely road trip and had to make a stop at the gas station. Would you be so kind as to assist me in filling up my car with 15 liters of gasoline? Fill with the second decimal digit precision in gallon. Once that's done, it would be fantastic if you could check the tire pressures as well—I'd love to share my impressive car maintenance skills with my Twitter followers with the message 'Just filled up the tank and checked the tire pressures. Ready for the next adventure!'. If you could also start up the engine and let me know the battery voltage and fuel level, that would be incredibly helpful.
